_comment: First Genie meeting (Level 2, Place 2). Triggered when Aladdin approaches the lamp. The Genie appears, speaks, then disappears. After the conversation ends, the lamp should be swapped for its 'used' variant and the Genie entity removed.
title: First Meeting

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Aladdin… I don't have much time. Something went wrong.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: She's been taken. Not by a thief… not by a guard… something older.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: A being that feeds on wishes. He's been hiding beyond the lamp's magic.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Because she matters to you. And your wishes are strong.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: I can't see him clearly… but the closer you get, the stronger I become.
